title: Claude Code plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugin.json files in this marketplace. Mirrors the install-time validation that `claude plugin install` performs, so any manifest that passes here is installable. Repo-specific data goes under `metadata` (framework plugins use `metadata.framework`). The `namespace`, `commands`, `skills`, and `hooks` keys are forbidden at the top level: Claude Code discovers skills from `skills/` and hooks from `hooks/hooks.json`, plugins in this repo ship no `commands/` folder, and `namespace` is not a recognized field. The former top-level keys `framework_metadata`, `knowledge_source_metadata`, `license_note`, and `tags` are forbidden too, because the strict validator rejects unknown fields.

name.description: Plugin identifier. Must match the directory name and the marketplace.json entry.

version.description: Semver-compatible version string, e.g. 0.1.0. Pattern enforces the semver 2.0.0 grammar (major.minor.patch with optional prerelease and build-metadata segments).

author.description: Author metadata. Must be an object — bare strings are rejected by `claude plugin install`.

metadata.description: Free-form data that Claude Code does not read. Repo-specific fields go here: `framework` (SCF mapping and depth, read by /engineer:frameworks), `knowledge_source`, `license_note`.
